title: TC-01: should show correlation tabs in log detail sidebar
verifies: Correlated Logs, Metrics, and Traces tabs are visible in the log detail sidebar

title: TC-02: should open correlation dashboard from log detail sidebar in embedded-tabs mode
verifies: Clicking a correlation tab in the detail sidebar loads embedded correlation content

title: TC-03: should open correlation dashboard dialog from log search inline button
verifies: Clicking the log-correlation-btn opens the dialog-mode ODrawer with dimension filter bar

title: TC-04: should switch between correlation tabs in dialog mode
verifies: Switching between Logs, Metrics, and Traces tabs renders each panel's content

title: TC-05: should toggle metric stream selection and update dashboard panels
verifies: Checking a metric stream in the sidebar toggles dashboard panels

title: TC-06: should apply dimension filter changes in dialog mode
verifies: Clicking Apply in the dimension filter bar re-fetches the dashboard

title: TC-07: should show and resolve correlation loading state
verifies: The loading spinner appears briefly and resolves to content or empty state

title: TC-08: should display no-traces empty state when no correlated traces exist
verifies: The Traces tab renders either an empty state, view button, or trace content without errors

title: TC-09: should close and reopen correlation dashboard dialog
verifies: Closing the ODrawer and reopening it works without stale state or duplicate fetches

title: TC-10: should preserve loaded data when switching tabs without refetching
verifies: Returning to a previously-loaded tab shows cached data without a new loading spinner

title: TC-11: should render correlation dashboard without errors in OSS mode
verifies: Correlation UI degrades gracefully in OSS builds without uncaught JS errors
